name: Ayame Riou
source: Tamaki's classmate. A young man who acts like a leader to everyone. His grades are among the best in his class. Even though he's only a second year student, he's also the student council president, dormitory president and class representative. His seniors and teachers respect him a lot. He takes good care of others, treats new students kindly and quickly makes new friends.
